_provenance.onpeak_window_min: NES GSA-3 (ottoq_depot_tariffs, source nespower.com gsa-123.pdf retrieved 2026-07-09) has NO time-of-use window: the demand charge is the non-coincident 30-min peak. The kernel's on-peak term is weighted 0 on the proposer path (frame_to_scenario sets onpeak_kw_min 0), so an empty window is the truthful declaration. The TOU variant TGSA-3 (1-7 PM CT Apr-Oct) is not the depot's schedule
